caption: The drawing depicts a single figure standing on a small, two-tiered wooden platform. The figure is wearing a short green tunic with yellow and white patterns, and a large red draped cloth that covers the left shoulder and crosses the torso. The figure's legs are adorned with yellow bands and white, circular decorations on the knees, and the feet are shown in grayish-blue footwear. The right arm is bent upwards holding a curved object, possibly a snake, which is brown with red and yellow markings. The left hand rests on the abdomen, partially covered by the red cloth. The figure wears a headdress composed of several tall feathers in red, yellow, cream, and dark green. The background is plain and unadorned, drawing all attention to the central figure. The artwork is rendered in a realistic manner with an emphasis on the detailed textures and patterns of the clothing, accessories, and feathers.
title: Cigar Store Indian
